# Content Identity Requirements Checklist: Web Content Hashing and Usage Descriptors

**Purpose**: Review whether hashing, cache reuse, descriptor, and ownership requirements are complete and unambiguous before implementation
**Created**: 2026-08-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command as a formal pre-implementation reviewer gate.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements present for all three public policies, their destinations, public paths, full digests, and exact tokens? [Completeness, Spec FR-001–FR-007]
- [x] CHK002 Are both positive cache-reuse inputs and byte-affecting invalidation inputs exhaustively classified? [Completeness, Spec FR-009–FR-012]
- [x] CHK003 Are descriptor versioning, serialization, artifact-reference, resolved-path, and caller-ownership requirements all stated? [Completeness, Spec FR-013–FR-015]
- [x] CHK004 Are the ordering of render, final-byte hash, destination resolution, preflight, publication, manifest update, and stale removal specified? [Completeness, Spec FR-016–FR-018]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the distinction between internal render fingerprint and public final-content identity explicit and free of overlapping terminology? [Clarity, Spec FR-008–FR-012]
- [x] CHK006 Is the compatibility default unambiguous when the policy object is omitted as well as when `none` is selected? [Clarity, Spec FR-001–FR-002; Assumptions]
- [x] CHK007 Are token derivation, exact use, default length, inclusive bounds, and identical-final-byte behavior precisely defined? [Clarity, Spec FR-003–FR-008; Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK008 Is query behavior precise about filename preservation, parameter name, configured public base, and deterministic single-parameter output? [Clarity, Spec FR-004; Assumptions; Edge Cases]

## Consistency and Compatibility

- [x] CHK009 Do filename/query result requirements agree with descriptor-path requirements and the complete current artifact catalog? [Consistency, Spec FR-003–FR-006 and FR-013–FR-014]
- [x] CHK010 Do obsolete-output requirements agree with whole-file ownership and the prohibition on unowned deletion? [Consistency, Spec FR-016–FR-018]
- [x] CHK011 Is the treatment of legacy `stable` and `content-hash` values compatible with the stated `none` default without retaining two callable vocabularies? [Consistency, Spec FR-002 and FR-019]
- [x] CHK012 Do all public failures remain within the stable `LOOM_` diagnostic contract? [Consistency, Spec FR-019; Constitution VI]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Can policy correctness be measured from destination, public path, full digest, and token without knowing implementation structure? [Measurability, SC-001]
- [x] CHK014 Can cache independence be measured as zero additional renderer invocations for each excluded-change class? [Measurability, SC-002]
- [x] CHK015 Can descriptor validity, ownership cleanup, consumer immutability, and repeated-run determinism each be objectively evaluated? [Measurability, SC-003–SC-006]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are primary, alternate, exception, recovery, and non-functional scenarios represented across user stories and edge cases? [Coverage, User Stories 1–4; Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are safe token boundaries, identical bytes after changed inputs, case-normalized collision, and partial-failure cleanup covered? [Edge Cases, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Are both manifest-owned predecessors and unowned lookalike files covered as distinct cleanup scenarios? [Coverage, User Story 4]
- [x] CHK019 Are publication-only changes distinguished from source/recipe/encoder/compatibility changes for cache decisions? [Coverage, User Story 2; FR-009–FR-012]

## Dependencies and Boundaries

- [x] CHK020 Are the ownership manifest, bounded publisher, recovery journal, focused package graph, and existing resource scope documented as dependencies or assumptions? [Dependencies, Plan Constitution Check; Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK021 Is consumer-project mutation excluded for every policy and descriptor integration path? [Boundary, Spec FR-015; SC-005]
- [x] CHK022 Is filename hashing explicitly recommended for immutable caching while remaining opt-in? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions]

- All 22 requirements-quality gates pass. The assignment fixes the intended depth (formal migration gate), audience (maintainer/reviewer), and highest-risk focus (content identity and ownership), so no checklist-scoping questions were necessary.
